test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 07 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that is similar in meaning to the underlined word.**

He gave a __concise__ explanation of the company's retirement plan.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Terse'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Concise **means giving a lot of information clearly and in a few words. (संक्षिप्त)

 
 
• Example- I need a **concise **account of the town's history.
 
 
 
• **Terse** means being brief and to the point. (संक्षिप्त)
 
 
• Example- The president made a **terse** statement.
 
 
 
• The two words are clearly similar in meaning so **'terse'** is the most appropriate option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Verbose **means using or expressed in more words than needed. (आवश्यकता से अधिक शब्दों में प्रयोग या व्यक्त किया गया)

 
 
• Example- Much academic language is obscure and **verbose**.
 
 
 
• **Clear **means easy to understand. (समझने में आसान)
 
 
• Example- She gave me **clear** and precise directions.
 
 
 
• **Sharp** means in a sudden or abrupt way. (अचानक तरीके से)
 
 
• Example- Take a **sharp **turn on the right.
